projects.name: Lumen
projects.oneLiner: Psychology-powered goal game — chic, streaky follow-through.
projects.summary: Name season and annual goals, check in daily, protect a streak, and play short “stuck games” when you drift. Dream Life Studio places a selfie into dream scenes before committing a vision. Conversion lab scores landing copy without live A/B traffic. Premium (AI coach, book, SMS journal) is waitlist-only for now.
